propositions: Code-review pipeline does not emit outcome_counts telemetry or record contract violations to verdict coverage, while plan-review pipeline does both inconsistently via non-shared implementation.

Contract-violation sink (ContextVar-backed collect/record/drain functions) is private to plan_review/orchestrator.py and must be moved to review_kernel as single shared implementation for both pipelines.

Outcome_counts (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) must be computed at merged *_decide boundary using shared helper deriving from available data, with unrecoverable always 0 due to workflow engine retry layer swallowing chunk-level errors.

Plan-review activates contract-violation sink in produce_plan_review_verdict and drains into coverage; code-review must activate same sink in _run_code_review_gate and drain into finalize_code_review_verdict coverage.
Outcome_counts and contract_violations are additive coverage keys only; no decision logic, verdict shape, or impact function changes required.
